guest_pay.note: Discover personal loan payments are made after logging in to the Account Center or app, through the automated phone line at 1-877-256-2632, or by mail.

help.title: Loan payment information
paragraphs: Log in to the Account Center or the Discover app to make or schedule a payment; online payments are effective on the date you schedule them. You can also enroll in automatic payments there.

Pay by phone through the automated system 24/7 at 1-877-256-2632 (choose option 1). By mail, send your check to Discover Personal Loans, PO Box 6105, Carol Stream, IL 60197-6105. Wire transfers and your own bank's bill pay also work.
There are no fees of any kind on a Discover personal loan and no prepayment penalty, so you can pay extra or pay the loan off early. Extra payments go to accrued interest first, then principal.

help.title: Automatic Payments
paragraphs: The free automatic payment program withdraws your regular monthly payment from your checking or savings account, and you can set a larger amount to pay the loan off faster. Enroll at any time: log in to the Account Center, select Payments and follow the prompts.

help.title: Statements and your due date
paragraphs: Statements are mailed about 20 days before your payment due date; you can switch to paperless statements in the Account Center. Your due date can be any day from the 2nd to the 27th of the month.
Change it in the Account Center or by calling 1-877-256-2632. You can change your due date two times over the life of the loan, with at least 12 months between requests.

help.title: Trouble making payments
paragraphs: If you have a temporary setback or a long-term hardship, call Discover's repayment assistance team at 1-877-256-2660 (TDD 1-866-710-3357) to talk about your options.

help.title: Contact Discover Personal Loans
paragraphs: Loan specialists: 1-866-248-1255, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 11 p.m. ET and Saturday to Sunday 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET. Hearing or speech impaired: dial 711.
